column1: # Expected shape keys, written from the Intel SDM vol. 2 (opcode map, appendix A; ModRM / SIB tables 2-2 and 2-3) and NOT computed by shape.py.
# Key = <bytes with immediate / displacement bytes zeroed>/<imm_offset>.<imm_size>.<disp_offset>.<disp_size> (shape.py docstring).
# columns: encoding hex, SDM row, key, family

column2: 8B /r MOV r32,r/m32; ModRM 45 = mod 01 rm 101 [EBP+disp8]: disp8 at byte 2
B8+rd id MOV r32,imm32: imm32 at byte 1
E8 cw/cd CALL rel32: the 4 bytes after the opcode are the target
83 /0 ib ADD r/m32,imm8; ModRM C0 = mod 11: no disp, imm8 at byte 2
8B /r MOV r32,r/m32; ModRM 04 = mod 00 rm 100 SIB; SIB 85 base 101 with mod 00 = disp32 at byte 3
6A ib PUSH imm8: imm8 at byte 1
0F 84 cd JZ rel32: 2 opcode bytes, the 4 bytes after them are the target
D9 /0 FLD m32fp; ModRM 45 = [EBP+disp8]: disp8 at byte 2
